transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Well... I guess I'm here because of church. 

The folks there... they said I was doing some odd things lately. Like at the potluck table. I guess I was just... standing there, holding the serving spoon up in the air. Just not moving. And... folding the same stack of napkins over and over again, while people were waiting on me. 

So... I don't know. That's why I came.
When you were standing there holding the spoon or folding the napkins, could you hear people talking to you or were you aware of what was happening around you?
I... well, I'm not too sure. I guess I just wasn't paying mind to much of anything right then. They said they were talking to me, but... I don't really remember hearing it.
Have you been hearing any voices or seeing things that other people around you do not seem to notice?
No... I don't think so. I haven't heard anything like that. Just... regular things, I guess.
Do you have any known medical conditions or have you recently taken any new medications or substances?
No... I don't think so. I ain't taking no new pills or nothing. Just... been the same as always, I suppose.
Have you noticed yourself repeating the words or movements of other people without meaning to?
No... I ain't noticed doing nothing like that. I don't think so, anyway.
When people at church asked you to do something, like move along or put the spoon down, did you find yourself intentionally doing the opposite of what they asked?
No... I wasn't doing that. I was just... doing what I was doing. I didn't mean to do the opposite or nothing.
During these times when you seem stuck or unresponsive, are you able to speak if you try, or do you find that you are completely unable to say anything at all?
I don't... I reckon I can speak if I need to. I ain't completely unable or nothing like that. Just... sometimes I just don't have nothing to say. I don't really know about being stuck.
When you are speaking with others, do you find that your thoughts get jumbled or that you have trouble keeping track of what you are trying to say?

Well... I guess sometimes. Like if the ladies ask me about blankets, or... choir practice. I mean to answer straight. But... I don't know, my words just run off on me. I end up talking about beans... or hymns, or my roses. Then folks just look at me... like they can't find what I'm saying. I don't really know why.
Can you tell me what day of the week it is today, and where exactly we are right now?
I... I ain't rightly sure what day it's gotten to be. I don't keep track so much. And we're... well, we're just here. In this office. I don't know much more than that.
Over the past several months or years, have you noticed that your memory or your ability to handle daily tasks, like managing money or keeping track of appointments, has been getting worse?

I... I ain't really noticed nothing like that. I just do what I need to do every day. I don't have much money to be managing anyway, and... well, I reckon I just get by the same as always. I don't really have appointments to keep track of.
Are there times during the day when you feel much clearer and more like yourself, or do you feel this way all the time?
I... I don't rightly know what you mean by clearer. I just... feel like me, I guess. It don't really change much from morning to night. I'm just the same all the time.
Do you find that there are times during the day when you are more alert and aware of your surroundings, and other times when you feel much more confused or drowsy?
No... I don't think so. I'm just awake when I'm awake. I don't really pay mind to being more alert or nothing. It's just a normal day.
If I were to give you three words to remember—like apple, table, and penny—and we talked for a few minutes, do you think you would be able to remember them for me?
I... I suppose so. I ain't really tried, but... I guess I could remember 'em if I had to.
Have you ever had any head injuries, seizures, or been told by a doctor that you have any problems with your brain or your blood chemistry?
No... I ain't never had no seizures or hit my head bad. And... well, doctors ain't never said nothing to me about my blood or my brain. It's all just fine, I suppose.

Are there times of the day when you find it harder to pay attention to what is happening around you than at other times, or is your ability to focus exactly the same from the moment you wake up until you go to sleep?
I... no, I reckon it's about the same all day. I don't really pay much mind to it. I just wake up and... well, go about my business till it's time for bed. Ain't noticed it being harder or nothing.
Are there specific times when you find yourself completely unable to move or speak for a while, even if you want to, or is your difficulty with movement or speech present all the time?

Well... I don't know about completely unable to move. But... that's kind of why I'm here. People at church... they said I was doing things. 

Like... standing by the potluck table. Just... holding the serving spoon up in the air. Not moving. And... well, sometimes I just keep folding the same stack of napkins. Over and over. Even when folks are waiting on me. I... I didn't really notice, but they said I was doing it.
Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have any underlying medical or physical health issues, even if they seem unrelated to your current concerns?
No... doctors haven't said anything like that. Just... regular checkups, I guess. Nothing special.
When you are speaking with others, do you ever find that your words get all jumbled up, or that you have trouble making sense to other people even when you are trying your best to be clear?

I... well, I suppose sometimes. Like when the ladies ask me about the blankets, or... choir practice. I mean to answer 'em straight. But... I don't know, my words just sort of run off. 

I'll go from talking about beans, to the hymns, and then my roses. They just... look at me. Like they can't find what I'm saying. I try to be clear, but... that's just how it comes out sometimes.
